name: Bon Jovi

whyMatters.en: New Jersey hard-rock/glam-metal radio: Livin' on a Prayer (1986) fixed talk-box riff + working-class chorus as late-80s stadium template beside Guns N' Roses grit.
whyMatters.zh: 新泽西 hard-rock/glam-metal 电台：Livin' on a Prayer（1986）把 talk-box riff + 工人阶级副歌钉成 80 年代末体育场模板，与 Guns N' Roses 砂感并列。

essentialTracks.title: You Give Love a Bad Name

lyricQuotes: Whoa, we're halfway there / Whoa-oh, livin' on a prayer
Shot through the heart / And you're to blame

shortBio.en: NJ hard-rock five; Slippery When Wet talk-box anthems, Livin' on a Prayer as 1986 stadium face.
shortBio.zh: 新泽西 hard-rock 五人；Slippery When Wet talk-box 颂歌，Livin' on a Prayer 作 1986 体育场面孔。

body.en:
Formed 1983 in Sayreville, NJ. Slippery When Wet (1986, Bruce Fairbairn; Desmond Child co-writes) is the citation LP: You Give Love a Bad Name opener hook, Livin' on a Prayer Sambora talk-box riff and gang chorus, Wanted Dead or Alive acoustic-to-electric ballad.

New Jersey (1988) extends the formula. Sambora exits 2013; It’s My Life (2000) is the later-catalog radio return. Craft is chorus engineering and talk-box guitar ID, not thrash density.
body.zh:
1983 年于新泽西 Sayreville 组建。Slippery When Wet（1986，Bruce Fairbairn；Desmond Child 合写）是引用 LP：You Give Love a Bad Name 开场钩子、Livin' on a Prayer 的 Sambora talk-box riff 与合唱副歌、Wanted Dead or Alive 原声到电声谣曲。

New Jersey（1988）延伸公式。Sambora 2013 年离队；It's My Life（2000）是后期目录电台回归。工艺在副歌工程与 talk-box 吉他 ID，非 thrash 密度。

body.en:
Bon Jovi write for chorus lift and Sambora talk-box as sonic logo. Slippery When Wet sits in glam-metal/hard-rock radio next to louder LA acts, with NJ working-class lyric framing.

Livin' on a Prayer is the citation track: riff identity + gang vocal.

Not thrash; arrangement is Fairbairn polish and Child hook craft.
body.zh:
Bon Jovi 为副歌抬升与 Sambora talk-box 声标写作。Slippery When Wet 坐在 glam-metal/hard-rock 电台，邻更响的洛杉矶乐队，用新泽西工人阶级歌词框。

Livin' on a Prayer 是引用曲：riff 身份 + 合唱人声。

非 thrash；编排是 Fairbairn 抛光与 Child 钩子工艺。

title.zh: 带 Sambora 的 Slippery 五人

body.en:
Classic five: Jon, Sambora, Bryan, Torres, Such. Such exits mid-90s; Hugh McDonald becomes touring/studio bass.

Sambora leaves 2013; Phil X covers lead guitar later.

Peak writing chemistry is Jon/Sambora/Child on Slippery / New Jersey.
body.zh:
经典五人：Jon、Sambora、Bryan、Torres、Such。Such 90 年代中离队；Hugh McDonald 成巡演/录音室贝斯。

Sambora 2013 年离队；后期 Phil X 顶主音吉他。

巅峰写作化学是 Slippery / New Jersey 上的 Jon/Sambora/Child。

title.zh: 体育场副歌 hard-rock 模板

body.en:
Later post-grunge and stadium rock copy the talk-box/chorus engineering more than the glam look.

It's My Life shows 2000s catalog revival of the same hook grammar.

Peer lane: Guns N' Roses grit vs Bon Jovi polish—same FM era, different sand.
body.zh:
后来后grunge 与体育场摇滚更多复制 talk-box/副歌工程，而非 glam 造型。

It's My Life 显示 2000 年代目录用同一钩子语法复兴。

同代车道：Guns N' Roses 砂感 vs Bon Jovi 抛光——同一 FM 时代，不同砂粒。
